findings.concern: JSON.parse would silently accept duplicate policy keys.
findings.resolution: The reader uses a strict JSON parser that rejects duplicate keys before schema validation.

findings.concern: Path configuration could escape the supplied corpus when readers are added.
findings.resolution: Root fields reject absolute paths, traversal, dot segments, empty segments and backslashes; targets reject absolute/traversal values.

findings.concern: Configuration could widen FFI proof semantics.
findings.resolution: Mechanisms are a closed vocabulary and the parser exposes only normalized configuration; it contains no scanner, artifact reader, database writer or graph mutation.

open: The next slice must adapt existing sidecar readers through an explicit example registry without preserving implicit built-ins.
